component.name: Demon's Souls (KytyPS5)
component.summary: Unofficial Linux launcher for the KytyPS5 emulator

description.p: A settings window for playing Demon's Souls (PS5) on Linux with KytyPS5 by chenxiao07. It downloads the official KytyPS5 Linux release, sets render resolution, AMD FSR 3 upscaling and frame generation, precompiles the shaders and keeps the emulator up to date. Not affiliated with Sony, Bluepoint Games, FromSoftware or the KytyPS5 developers; no game files are included.
